query: SELECT TOP 64 source_id, designation, ref_epoch, ra, dec, ra_error, dec_error, parallax, parallax_error, pmra, pmdec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE random_index < 100000 AND astrometric_params_solved = 31 AND ra IS NOT NULL AND dec IS NOT NULL ORDER BY random_index
selection: Lowest random_index rows in bounded 0..99999 subset, five-parameter astrometric solutions only
